headline: Ethiopia: "The Country Is Establishing a Solid Financial Sector to Drive Sustainable Growth," Says Central Bank Governor
summary: Ethiopia is building a solid and dynamic financial sector to support development and sustainable economic growth, said Eyob Tekalign, Governor of the National Bank of Ethiopia.
why: The National Bank of Ethiopia sets monetary and financial-sector policy, which shapes banking reform and foreign investment opportunities in the country.
